prediction_text: 这门婚事能重新促成、能成：木星擢升以六合把七宫主土星之力转递给上升主太阳，中途无禁止、截断或挫败，相位将于6月27日完善——这是复合成婚的决定性转递之光。男方先主动：按盘面进程，6月19日近午为男方先开口/先行动之时，主坐标6月27日相位完善前后婚议落定。中间有迟滞：月亮空亡后对冲太阳、女方此前拒绝造成的体面顾虑会拖慢，但不翻盘。
basis: systems_used=['horary (Lilly, 7th-house marriage)']; Jupiter exalted applying sextile Saturn lord 7th transferring to Sun lord Asc with no prohibition/abscission/frustration before perfection (27 June, given) is Lilly's strongest revival testimony; Venus-Moon and Sun-Venus receptions corroborate mutual inclination; Moon void then opposition Sun accounts for delay/honour difficulty only. Timing from given 19 June initiative and 27 June perfection dates.
